name: Brand identity design
description: We design visual identities for new businesses and established brands ready for a refresh. We develop your logo, colours, typography and visual style so your brand looks consistent across your website, social media and printed materials.
bestFor: New businesses, and established brands ready for a refresh.
howItStarts: With a brief: we get to know your business, who you want to reach and how you want people to see your brand.

phases.title: Brief
phases.description: We get to know your business, who you want to reach and how you want people to see your brand.

phases.title: Moodboard
phases.description: We put together a moodboard with colour, typography and visual references. We agree on a direction with you before developing the identity.

phases.title: Branding
phases.description: We turn the agreed direction into a visual identity, developing your logo and the design elements that work alongside it.

phases.title: Deliverables
phases.description: We hand over your final brand files for digital and print, with guidelines so you and your team know how to use them.
